         ASIMINA TRILOBA

       American Papaw


Produces a series of symptoms much like scarlet fever; sore throat, fever,
      vomiting, scarlet eruption; tonsils and submaxillary glands enlarged, with diarrhœa. Fauces
      red and swollen, face swollen. Desire for ice-cold things.   Hoarseness  .
      Languid, drowsy irritable.


Acne. Itching in evening on undressing.



Relationship.--  Compare:   Capsic; Bellad  .
